decision: Use KallistiOS GCC and the existing console gateway instead of waiting for Zig
why: Released Zig cannot emit SH-4 and the LLVM SuperH target remains a draft

decision: Keep the existing MPXG and MPXP gateway contracts and add a Dreamcast client
why: GameCube already proves the server-side Plex catalog and transcode boundary

decision: Use short MPEG-1 and mono MP2 segments through KOS libmpeg
why: The pinned toolchain ships a Dreamcast MPEG-1 player and 16 MB RAM rules out buffering 120-second clips

decision: Replaced demo state with catalog-backed connection and playback states
why: The UI must not report success before the gateway and media services complete

decision: Added strict MPXG v3 and MPXP v2 parsers
why: Dreamcast can share the existing console gateway without sharing the unavailable Zig archive

decision: Added a bounded HTTP/1.1 client with an actual socket integration test
why: KallistiOS exposes the same BSD socket calls used by the host test
